segments.subgoal: Explain the three categories of interaction techniques used in immersive environments.
Describe the primary distinction between object selection and object manipulation.
Identify the key parameters that influence user performance during object selection.
Explain various hand selection techniques, including travel techniques like go-go and prism.
Describe pointing-based selection techniques and improvements like bend cast and depth ray.
Explain image plane and volumetric selection techniques for 2D and 3D regions.
Describe the goal of object manipulation and its various categories.
Explain hand manipulation as an intuitive way to modify object properties.
Describe indirect manipulation techniques using 3D widgets, proxies, and World in Miniature.
Explain bimanual manipulation techniques, including spindle and spindle plus wheel.
Describe the integrated hybrid manipulation technique known as HOMER.
Summarize the main points of the lecture.
